hints.title: N-ary Root First Traversal
hints.text: Record the current node valuation before recursively or iteratively exploring each offspring subbranch from left to right.

hints.title: Recursive Depth-First Sequence
hints.text: Base case returns empty on null root. Append current value to result list, then iterate through children list calling preorder on each.

hints.title: Preorder Blueprint
hints.text: Define res = []. Helper dfs(node): if not node: return. res.append(node.val). For child in node.children: dfs(child). Invoke dfs(root) and return res.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total nodes in n-ary tree
complexity.notes: Visits every node once in linear time with recursion stack proportional to tree depth.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Binary tree assumptions fail because each node may have arbitrary numbers of children.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear time traversal with recursion stack auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of empty root and iterating children list in natural order.
